blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven V142 renders shows the longer hem adds modest neutral coverage only; crouch still lifts the skirt and exposes upper thighs, while sitting and prone bunch or lift the shell into rigid angular shapes.
The skirt remains a uniformly flared shell with faint panel folds. The waist-to-hip join is abrupt, with a projecting shelf and visible side intersections.
Torso faceting and discontinuities around the side, waist, and hip remain visible in front, side, back, and pose evidence.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
